review.notes: needs_changes. The README states the plan faithfully: all 210 nodes, 420 API names and 271 named checks are present, definitions have at least three Checks, and the author's corrections (§1.13 real Kottwitz sign (−1)^⌊n²/4⌋ for compact U(n), §4.8 DKV sign convention, §§3.6, 3.12, 3.15 Hitchin degeneracies) check out. lean-check on the unchanged Suggested.lean: exit 0, 16 warnings, all 'declaration uses sorry'; its ten light definitions and all signatures were checked by hand. Fixed in place (75 scripted edits): 206 run-together hypothesis lines; 14 wrong internal cross-references in text and 16 in Needs lines (a shift by one in Layer 6); five L-packet passages wrongly rewritten as 'this roadmap'; the plan's 'continuous unitary' and 'not unique' restored in §6.3; the tier-14 FarguesFontaineDiamonds F4 citation in §12.9 replaced by §12.1; five locator page ranges from a 22-citation random source sample; 29 extraction-item and 'not read' remarks; a boundary sentence on upstream SmoothRepresentationsOfLocalGroups SR.5.2, which states rec as an input theorem. Sent back because the supplier layer has gaps a review cannot fill: 49 contract bullets (and 46 Needs items) are only partly supplied or not supplied by the cited roadmaps. About thirty are theorems that no cited roadmap states (e.g. Henniart's highly ramified stability, segment and nongeneric factor formulas, Vogan's archimedean irreducibility, the Matsushima count for U(N−1,1), Schneider–Zink types and newvectors, the GL_r(D) Langlands classification, the Hitchin stack inputs mislabelled R09.4, the DM-stack decomposition theorem and trace formula, deformation spaces with Drinfeld levels, ℓ-adic nearby cycles on their algebraizations, locally analytic vectors in the tower). They must become targets here or in a SmoothRepresentationsOfLocalGroups Part II. Also remaining: about 200 process sentences, 199 Needs references by plan node id, the 'Primary proof requirements' section, duplicate references and Checks, and §12.22's unsourced action dictionary. The report gives an item-by-item ledger with a resolution for each.
